PRODUCT DATA SHEET: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: PRODUCT DATA SHEET, edition not printed (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/o/sika_aktivator-205.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide PRODUCT DATA SHEET where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (edition not printed).
1.2 Product description. Refer to manufacturer. This is not stated in the data sheet reviewed (edition not printed).
1.3 Intended uses. Refer to manufacturer. This is not stated in the data sheet reviewed (edition not printed).

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. PRODUCT DATA SHEET
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (edition not printed) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - CQP001-1: Sika internal procedure reference, not a published standard. Where:  > PRODUCT DATA SHEET (p.1).

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (edition not printed) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (edition not printed) and the requirements below.
4.2 .     | Sika® Aktivator-205 is a solvent-based, colourless, clear adhesion promoter which reacts with moisture and deposits active groups on the substrate. These groups act as a link between substrates and primers or sealants / adhesives. Sika® Aktivator-205 is designed for the treatment of bond faces prior to application of Sikaflex® and Sikasil® adhesives and sealants. | Enhanced adhesion on various substrates Short flash-off time Easy to use Transparent |

In order to maintain product quality it is important to reseal the container immediately after use. Once the surface pre-treatment operation is completed the cap has to be screwed on. Prolonged exposure to atmospheric moisture will cause Sika® Aktivator- 205 to become inactive. Immediately discard Sika® Aktivator-205 if it has become opaque instead of clear. Dispose of product approx. one month after opening if used frequently or after two months in case of infrequent use. Never dilute or mix Sika® Aktivator-205 with any other substances. It must not be used for tooling/smoothing of products or as cleaning agent.     AREAS OF APPLICATION Sika® Aktivator-205 is used to improve adhesion on non-porous substrates such as metals, plastics, ceramic screen prints and painted surfaces. Seek manufacturer’s advice and perform tests on original substrates before using Sika® Aktivator-205 on materials prone to stress cracking. This product is suitable for experienced professional users only. Tests with actual substrates and conditions have to be performed to ensure adhesion and material compatibility.
    Application
    Wipe bond faces with a clean, lint-free paper towel moistened (not wet) with Sika® Aktivator-205. Never dip the towel into the activator.
    Only wipe the surface with a clean side of the towel. Do not moisten the same paper towel twice and change it frequently.
    Sika® Aktivator-205 has to be applied sparingly as excess of activator could lead to adhesion failure.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (edition not printed) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
